name: Telecom quantum-dot single-photon-source autocorrelation at 4 K (Thomas et al.2024 source subsystem)
plain_name: Measure the single-photon purity of a semiconductor quantum-dot emitter
description: Measure the single-photon purity of a semiconductor quantum-dot emitter. A bounded, source-grounded procedure profile; compatibility covers the listed checks and does not guarantee measured scientific performance.

sources.citation: Thomas et al. (2024), Deterministic storage and retrieval of telecom light from a quantum dot single-photon source interfaced with an atomic quantum memory, Science Advances 10, eadi7346

requirements.rationale: Replicate the published4 K emitter sample environment. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.
Excitation and collection need a real optical path to the emitter. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.
Pulsed excitation and collection optics are essential. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.
A beam splitter and two detector paths are essential to g(2) measurement. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.
The published setup measures correlations with a time tagger. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.

missing_information: The source-only profile does not certify the paper's warm atomic-memory interface.
QD material preparation, pump spectral width, filter response, detector efficiency and coincidence calibration need separate review; g(2)(0) is not hardcoded.
confirmation_note: Profile author reviewed these exact sourced conditions on 2026-10-31. The application must still require the user's review/confirmation; all edits invalidate confirmation.
